stories.headline: President Lai Ching-te announces major defense budget increase and nuclear policy review
stories.summary: President Lai announced a 1.25 trillion NT dollar eight-year defense budget and defended his administration's review of nuclear power restart alongside continued green energy development. He marked 30 years of Taiwan's direct presidential elections and vowed to resist the CCP.

stories.headline: Beijing condemns Lai Ching-te over comments comparing Japanese colonial rule to early KMT period
stories.summary: Chinese government and state media accused President Lai of 'glorifying Japanese colonial rule' after he made comparisons between Japanese colonial period and early KMT rule over Taiwan. Beijing called his remarks an attempt to distort history and promote Taiwan independence.

stories.headline: Premier Cho Jung-tai's Japan trip to watch World Baseball Classic sparks political controversy
stories.summary: Premier Cho's personal visit to Tokyo to watch Taiwan's WBC game drew criticism and praise, with opponents questioning the trip's appropriateness while supporters called it 'baseball diplomacy.' He emphasized that China has neither given up using force against Taiwan nor slowed military spending.

stories.headline: Premier Cho Jung-tai expands migrant domestic helper eligibility with new fee structure
stories.summary: Premier Cho approved expansion of eligibility to hire migrant domestic helpers, with employers required to pay monthly fees between NT$2,000 and NT$10,000 to fund Ministry of Labor measures aimed at mitigating impacts on Taiwanese workers.
